letter_axis.note: A=0 ... V=21, increases toward playfield north

grid.note: Squares are one inch (2.54 cm) both ways; cm_per_v is 2.561 because the camera reads playfield y 0.8% long.

addressing.S: S<letter><number> names a square by its centre: SN15 = (u=15, v=13).
addressing.G: G<letter><number> names the grid-line crossing at the NW (playfield frame, +u +v) corner of that square: GN15 = (u=15.5, v=13.5).
addressing.bare: A label without S or G is rejected; the mat prints labels between a line and a square, so the prefix is required.

tags.placement: tag centre on the G crossing of the labelled square, i.e. at (u+0.5, v+0.5)

image.axes: x right = mat -u direction (toward playfield east), y down = mat -v direction (toward playfield south)

grid.formula: u = u_at_px0 - x/(px_per_cm*cm_per_u);  v = v_at_px0 - y/(px_per_cm*cm_per_v)
grid.fit: u: GB35 (aruco 5) and GU-8 (aruco 6) are 43 squares apart and measure 2.5405 cm/square (1 inch). v: printed inch ticks on the Start-box edge measure 2.561 cm in this camera (0.8% long), anchored on GU-8. 2026-10-21

pose.formula: playfield = R(theta) @ [x/px_per_cm, -y/px_per_cm] + [x_cm, y_cm]  (template pixel (0,0) is at (x_cm,y_cm))

fiducials.note: Every mat carries two ArUco tags at these two crossings; the tag ids differ per mat.
